why: The half-fix, and the one worth pinning separately: giving the winner a way out and leaving the loser without one. It is the more likely regression than removing the route entirely, because the win screens keep working and only the state a developer is least likely to sit on stays broken. Every assertion about the intermediate-clear panel -- the case that HAD this button before issue #323 -- survives it.
